assumptions.statement: The submitted site polygon is the repository provisional constraint, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All design geometry, ratios, figures and locations must be regenerated after official geometry arrives.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of official or cleared SITE_BOUNDARY.

assumptions.statement: All three key-area polygons are rough repository constraints; the Dazhongsi station relationship is unresolved.
assumptions.impact: Key-area layouts describe relocatable relationships and make no parcel or station-distance claim.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of the three official KEY_AREA polygons and station access evidence.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, heritage and structural conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, density, height, demolition, engineering alignment, cost and programme remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: No seasonal species, habitat, tree, soil, microclimate or hydrological field baseline has been completed.
assumptions.impact: Habitat components are methods and concept envelopes only; species and performance claims are prohibited.

assumptions.statement: All twelve scenarios and four industrial pilots are design protocols, not operating services or completed tests.
assumptions.impact: Published results remain zero; authorization, operator, baseline, denominator, stop and recovery must precede any trial.

assumptions.statement: No children, carers, disabled users, residents or maintenance workers have yet participated in site-specific co-design.
assumptions.impact: Persona and accessibility responses require facilitated field validation and cannot be treated as user endorsement.
